description: Create or extend the rikma's option axes — e.g. Size (S, M, L) and Colour (Red #d22, Blue #22d). Axes belong to the rikma and are shared by its products; an axis with the same key gains the new values and keeps the old ones (another product may sell them), labels and swatch colours are updated. Operational: applied at once. Up to 3 axes per call and 30 values per axis. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#upsertProductOptionsTool

key.description: Stable key (default: derived from the name), e.g. "size".

name.description: Option name as shoppers see it, e.g. "Size" / "מידה".

value.description: Stable value key (default: derived from the label).

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.

name: upsertProductOptionsTool
